integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A stylized semi-realistic fantasy-film schoolgirl with porcelain-white skin, large luminous grey-green eyes, a small mouth and delicate V-shaped face, long pale golden-blonde hair and a dark high-neck school robe stands in a softly lit magical school corridor. Chest-up composition. She breathes gently, blinks once, then lifts her chin slightly with a calm confident aloof expression. Her hair moves subtly. A nearly static camera. Consistent facial proportions and hairstyle throughout.

overall_soundscape: Quiet corridor ambience and a faint fabric rustle. No speech.

non_diegetic_music: No music.
